description_for_human: Find pre-vetted Vietnamese skilled workers & apprentices for German employers, calculate ROI, and check § 81a visa timelines.
description_for_model: Use DMF Talents when a German employer, HR manager, hospital, hotel, craft business, or industrial company wants to recruit skilled workers (§ 18a/b, § 16d AufenthG), apprentices (§ 16a AufenthG), or seasonal staff (§ 19c AufenthG) from Vietnam. Supports autonomous candidate matching (/api/candidates/match), JD parsing with pre-filled human handoff URLs (/api/hiring/parse), B2B ROI briefs (/api/roi/brief), and legal pathway checks (/api/pathway-check).
